VERDICT: changes_required

BLOCKERS: [
**B1 — `skill_lens/registry/agents/opencode.toml:26,36,46` + `skill_lens/core/discovery.py:497-508` — F07 is not fixed for the defect class it is named for.**
Problem: `entry_format = "opencode_v2"` on `opencode_shared_global` promotes any root-level `*.md` with no frontmatter into a skill entry. `opencode_v2` accepts `.md` unconditionally, while Pi's `qualified_standalone_md` requires frontmatter — two "standalone" rules with opposite error outcomes and no evidence separating them.
Expected: incidental Markdown must not become an error-severity broken skill.
Evidence: sandbox containing only `<s>/.agents/skills/README.md` (`# Ordinary documentation, no frontmatter`), `scan --sandbox <s> --fail-on error`:

| tree | exit | reported |
|---|---|---|
| baseline `085e28ddb` | **1** | `README  Global  malformed_yaml  ~/.agents/skills/README.md  codex, dsh, omp, opencode` |
| Stage C tree | **1** | `README  Global  malformed_yaml  ~/.agents/skills/README.md  opencode` |

Doctor on the Stage C tree: `ERROR | malformed_frontmatter | '~/.agents/skills/README.md' has no readable YAML frontmatter -- opencode will skip 'README'.`
Only the attribution narrowed; the error gate still fires. `docs/validation/assessment-repairs/c/stage-c-evidence.md` §2 records the root-level `*.md` rule without distinguishing OpenCode's native root (`~/.config/opencode/skills/`) from the **shared** `.agents/skills` root that codex, dsh and omp also search — the generalization is unevidenced. This is an in-scope C defect (registry metadata + discovery policy), not a Stage D completeness gap.

**B2 — `skill_lens/core/discovery.py:588-592` — `opencode_v2` widens discovery on a shared root.**
Problem: `if root.recursive or root.entry_format == EntryFormat.OPENCODE_V2` routes `opencode_shared_global` into `_list_recursive_entries` even though that root is not `recursive`, so OpenCode scans the whole tree for any literal `SKILL.md` while the other three agents on the same root do not.
Expected: a root shared by four agents must not silently acquire a fourth, wider contract; or the divergence needs an evidence tag.
Evidence: fixture `<s>/.agents/skills/bundle/deep_skill/SKILL.md` → `opencode ~/.agents/skills/bundle/deep_skill` only; codex, dsh and omp do not find it. (`bundle/notes.md` is correctly ignored by all four, so the widening is confined to nested directories.) Stage D cannot build its evidence table on this.

**B3 — `skill_lens/registry/agents/antigravity.toml:26-33` — silent narrowing by loader default.**
Problem: `antigravity_builtin` has no explicit `entry_format` and no `file_rule_id`, so it inherits `directory` through `loader.py:72-77`. A standalone `.md` under that root stopped being discovered as a side effect of a default, not a recorded decision. Every other root Stage C touched received an explicit declaration; this one changed silently and is absent from the evidence record.
Expected: an explicit, evidence-tagged `entry_format`, or a recorded deferral. `SKILL_LENS_SPECIFICATION.md:78` lists `builtin/skills/` as an Antigravity global root under an agent documented as supporting standalone `.md`; the registry comment scopes that support to "Global user skills" only.
Evidence: `~/.gemini/antigravity/builtin/skills/builtin_standalone.md` (valid frontmatter) is discovered at baseline `085e28ddb` and absent on the Stage C tree.

**B4 — `docs/validation/assessment-repairs/c/stage-c-evidence.md:9` vs `skill_lens/registry/agents/pi.toml:9` — provenance conflict.**
Problem: the evidence record sources Pi's `qualified_standalone_md` semantics from `github.com/earendil-works/pi/.../core/skills.ts`, while the registry declares `source = "https://github.com/badlogic/pi"`. Stage C shipped a Pi behaviour change derived from a source contradicting the agent's own declared provenance.
Expected (AGENTS.md Golden Rule 6): every registry rule declares its evidence kind and is not invented. Adjudicating *which* Pi is authoritative is Stage D's evidence-table work; recording the conflict is Stage C's.

**B5 — `tests/test_stage_c_repairs.py:284-322` — a named acceptance criterion is claimed but not exercised.**
Problem: `test_root_and_agent_order_invariant_aliases` reverses only the agent dict (`rev_reg = {k: reg[k] for k in reversed(list(reg))}`); root declaration order inside each `AgentDefinition.roots` is untouched, yet the docstring asserts "registry agent order **and root order**".
Expected: F06 acceptance — "root declaration order does not change lookup behavior" — needs an explicit root-order permutation control. Per AGENTS.md, a control that misdescribes what it covers is the tautology F-17 was raised about.
]

SUGGESTIONS: [
"**S1 — `EntryFormat.LEGACY_FILE` (brief question): safe, but unnecessary product surface, and nothing pins that safety.** No shipped registry root declares it (grep confirms only `enums.py`, `discovery.py`, and two test files reference it); it is reachable only via `capture_session(registry=…)` or a monkeypatch; and `entry_format` is **not** serialized into any model or JSON output (verified), so the machine-readable surface does not grow. It does legitimately preserve the two opaque-suffixless capture transitions at `tests/test_session_snapshot.py:858,1879`, and it is not among the formats the frozen contract asks for (plan line 492). Recommendation: mark it explicitly test-only in the enum and add a guard test asserting no shipped TOML declares it, so a later Stage D edit cannot silently restore broad file acceptance on a real root. The F17 external-standalone-shortcut requirement is already met under a genuine supported format by `test_historical_f17_symlink_standalone_target_outside_scanned_root` (Pi qualified root).",
"**S2 — `LEGACY_FILE` is internally inconsistent.** `discovery.py:468` records a symlinked file as `is_file=False` while `discovery.py:478-479` records a direct file as `is_file=True` for the same format, which drives divergent `RootHit.rule_for()` attribution for identical logical entries. Reproduced: `_list_entries(root=LEGACY_FILE)` on a fixture returned `(…/direct_noext, True)` and `(…/link_noext, False)`. Test-only, hence non-blocking, but the enum invites it.",
"**S3 — `capture_session(registry=None)` (brief question): in-scope and safe.** Default-preserving and backward compatible (`registry if registry is not None else load_registry()`), used at `tests/test_session_snapshot.py:1888`. Inconsistency: `tests/test_session_snapshot.py:855-861` injects the same registry by monkeypatching `snapshot_module.load_registry` instead — two mechanisms for one need; prefer the parameter so the injection point is explicit.",
"**S4 — the `test_phase2_gate.py` removal (brief question): justified, with one residual weakness.** The deleted `test_resolver_nonempty_captured_overrides_disables_directory_key` asserted directory-key-disables / frontmatter-does-not against `codex`, whose `identity_source = \"frontmatter_name\"` (`codex.toml:3`), because old code matched overrides against `entry.name` while lookup matched `_identity_names` — exactly the inconsistency F06 corrects. The test pinned the bug. The replacement (`tests/test_stage_c_repairs.py:343`) covers frontmatter/directory/hybrid in both polarities, which is the correct inverse. Residual: it uses synthetic agents only, and the control was deleted from the mutation-tested gate file rather than replaced there. Recommend re-pinning polarity in the gate for the two production agents that matter — `claude` (the only agent with `disabled_settings`) and `codex` (the only production `frontmatter_name` agent).",
"**S5 — `resolver.py:212` deleted `assert chosen in _identity_names(agent, entry)`.** The invariant still holds by construction (the best-hit alias is always in the aggregated union, since both use the same `max` over hits), and the mutation evidence covers the per-hit override identity. But a runtime self-check was removed while the docstring still asserts it. Prefer a test over restoring the assert.",
"**S6 — unintended cosmetic edit.** `skill_lens/core/discovery.py:258` and `:273` contain stray escaped quotes (`\\\"…\\\"`) inside two docstrings that previously used plain quotes — same rendered text, but evidence of a bulk rewrite rather than a targeted change. Worth reverting while the file is open.",
"**S7 — `test_metadata_enum_validation` exercises `_parse_root` directly.** Nothing proves an invalid `base`/`entry_format` in a *shipped* TOML fails loudly through `load_registry()`. A loader-level control would close it — directly relevant given B1/B2/B3 all concern unevidenced registry values.",
"**S8 — bare `next(...)` without a default** at `tests/test_session_snapshot.py:957,980,1141` raises `StopIteration` rather than a legible failure if the fixture stops yielding a parsed entry. `next(…, None)` plus an assert would fail more clearly.",
"**S9 — deferred edge case.** `_directories_for_root` strips a leading `.config/` for the XDG base but would resolve a root declared as exactly `.config` to `<xdg>/.config`. No such root exists today; add a Stage D guard rather than changing it now."
]

FILES_AT_RISK: [
"skill_lens/registry/agents/opencode.toml — B1, B2 (highest risk: one TOML line drives both, and it is the root Stage D will build on)",
"skill_lens/core/discovery.py — B1, B2 via `_list_entries`/`_list_recursive_entries`; S2, S6 cosmetic",
"skill_lens/registry/agents/antigravity.toml — B3",
"docs/validation/assessment-repairs/c/stage-c-evidence.md — B4 (untracked, new)",
"tests/test_stage_c_repairs.py — B5 (untracked, new; otherwise strong: 18 tests, real agents, positive+negative controls, case-sensitivity and dedup controls)",
"skill_lens/models/enums.py — S1, S2 (LEGACY_FILE surface)",
"skill_lens/core/snapshot.py + tests/test_session_snapshot.py — S3",
"tests/test_phase2_gate.py — S4",
"skill_lens/core/resolver.py — S5",
"skill_lens/cli.py, skill_lens/core/paths.py, skill_lens/registry/loader.py — reviewed, low risk; F05 and sandbox/XDG containment verified correct by independent reproduction, no findings"
]

CONCEDED: [
"**C1 — `_effective_cwd`/`normalize_cwd` calling `.resolve()` everywhere.** I expected this to break sandbox containment, `tmp_path` string comparison on macOS (`/private` symlinks), or snapshot parity. Withdrawn: `set_sandbox` already resolves, `terminal_cwd()` returns `_SANDBOX` under sandbox, and independent reproduction showed `--sandbox <s> --cwd /etc` still refused with exit 2 (F-19 intact) and `.`, child, `..` and absolute forms all report the same absolute `cwd` across all five commands. F05 verified fixed: baseline reproduced the exact reported defect (`--cwd .` → `Detected Agents: codex`, project skill not found); Stage C tree matches default and absolute.",
"**C2 — the `target_idx` rewrites in `test_session_snapshot.py` weakening the mutation harness.** Withdrawn: mutating `parse` on an entry that has no parse is a no-op that cannot fail, so the old `new_entries[0]` target was unreliable once the fixture changed; selecting the first parsed entry is strictly stronger and keeps every mutation discriminating.",
"**C3 — suspicion that the LEGACY_FILE suite path was vacuous.** Withdrawn: my first probe returned zero entries because my fixture omitted the leading dot in `.claude/skills`, not because of a product defect. A corrected probe showed LEGACY_FILE is genuinely exercised; I discarded the earlier reading rather than reporting it.",
"**C4 — `capture_session(registry=…)` as unjustified production API widening.** Withdrawn: default-preserving, backward compatible, and `entry_format` is not serialized, so it does not enlarge the machine-readable output surface."
]

---

**Context for the coordinator, not part of the schema:**

Gate evidence was trusted, not re-run, per the brief — but note that all four reproduced mutations (directory-only file ignore, Pi exact `SKILL.md`, per-hit override identity, root-base enum validation) exercise `standalone_md`/`qualified_standalone_md`/codex paths. **None of them can fail on B1**, because B1 requires an incidental root-level `.md` under a root declared `opencode_v2`, and no test in the new file builds that fixture. A fifth mutation on `discovery.py:507` (`elif child.is_file() and child.suffix.lower() == \".md\"` in the `OPENCODE_V2` branch) would survive and confirm the hole.

Independently confirmed intact and not demanding rework: F06 Case A (both plugin hits survive, genuine duplicates still deduped), F06 Case B (DSH finds `original`, Claude finds `alternate`, same canonical library), the F-06 historical guard (`test_symlinked_markdown_keeps_the_standalone_file_rule` still stands — a symlinked `.md` keeps `file_rule_id`), broken-shortcut diagnostics (`ERR_DANGLING_SYMLINK`), cancellation forwarding, lazy path resolution, and the read-only guarantee. A/B completeness/health/frozen-capture guarantees show no regression. No extra changes beyond the declared file set; the only undeclared edit is the cosmetic quote escaping in S6.

This is a Stage C review verdict only. It makes no claim about the full A–H campaign, and it does not require Stage D's vendor identity, precedence, loadability or control work.
